intent: A character-led costume material study of an original 36-year-old woman healer: warm, practical and quietly firm. Her clothes belong to an inhabited Chinese fantasy drama; convey careful workmanship through an ordinary fabric and wearable cut, without luxury ornaments.

subjects.description: An original adult woman with a broad gentle face, clear mature eyes and natural proportionate figure; dark hair folded into a practical low braided knot, held by a small plain wooden pin.
appearance: An opaque apricot cotton-linen wrap jacket, side-fastened with fabric ties, over a cream fine-weave inner layer and a muted moss-green straight skirt. Comfortable waist shaping, narrowed cuffs and a side slit allow work; no long trailing sleeves.

The apricot fabric is tightly and evenly woven with small natural yarn variation, soft edge thickness and fine hand-sewn seams. Elbow folds compress and deepen, shoulder cloth falls with moderate weight; the cream inner facing is smoother and finer than the outer jacket.

No embroidered borders, metal ornament, translucent fabric or armor on this practical outfit. Its quality rests on cut, restrained material texture, well-finished hems and the honest meeting of layers.
subjects.action: Standing with one hand adjusting the folded cuff while looking calmly toward a waiting visitor just outside frame.

scene.summary: Knee-up three-quarter view, eye-level portrait perspective. A quiet plaster-and-timber clinic doorway with soft side daylight; background low contrast. Garment chest, cuff, waist and upper skirt are large and sharply readable, face naturally clear. Real photographic textile behavior, neutral color rendition, no atmospheric veil over clothes.
